title: BlackLanturn Build 1.1.58
summary: More reliable browsing, watched-status refresh and playback return, with clearer source fallback messages.

sections.heading: Smoother browsing and playback
bullets: Late row updates keep your current title and selection in place.
Watched-status refresh runs without blocking Play or resetting your selection.
Duplicate page requests are combined and retired views are released before playback.

sections.heading: Clearer menus
bullets: Confirmation buttons stay inside their panel.
Play Next briefly explains when size/service matching or opening sources requires manual selection.

sections.heading: Your setup stays saved
bullets: Use Update BlackLanturn to keep settings, accounts, history and other installed add-ons.
Included add-ons and tested BlackLanturn patches update together. No new monitoring service is added.
